context.p: A Search and Select Action on the object that corresponds to the lookup value field must exist. For example, if you need an account lookup, there must be a Search and Select Action on the Account object.

step.cmd: Select a Display Map and click Edit. The Display Map panel opens.
In the Mapped Details section of the Display Map pane, click the magnify icon to open lookup properties for that field.
Select the applicable Search and Select Actions.
In the Mapped Record ID field, select the record ID field and click Save.

info.p: This ensures that the correct lookup will be returned to the record. To remove an existing Online Lookup, click Remove.
